title: ?accept= filter passes /foo and foo/ — invalid MIME type through validation
description: blob_download_handler validates ?accept= by checking exactly one '/' is present, but does not verify the slash is not at position 0 or end. '/foo' and 'foo/' pass the check and are emitted as Content-Type. While not directly exploitable alone, they bypass the single-slash sanity check and could confuse browser MIME sniffing. Fix: additionally verify the slash is not first or last character.
